props.title: A DJ, a party band, or the band that hands over the microphone.
props.lede: A Halloween party is a floor first and a dinner second, if it’s a dinner at all.

rows.text: The usual first question, and the easiest one for a house. A DJ plays the songs a costume crowd wants, built around the decade your guests grew up in, with the songs that have to happen placed where you want them, and it runs as late as the house allows.

A trio or a quartet playing the hits to a floor with no stage in it. Tony Medina plays it up to a four piece, and Tejas Singh plays a quartet built from the songs everyone in the house knows. Either can play the early part of the night quietly before the floor turns.

The band plays the 80s and 90s hits on its own, sung out front, and hands the microphone to anyone in costume who wants a song. The person dressed as Prince is going to sing Prince, and the band is ready the moment they get brave. Live band karaoke wants a big main floor, a finished basement or a garage with the cars out.

items.q: Do you have a DJ for a Halloween party?
items.a: Yes. A DJ is the usual first question for a Halloween party and the easiest one for a house, with a set built around the decade your guests grew up in. It's one contract with sound support sized to the house, booked through Signet Artists in Denver, and the same DJ can take the late end of a night after a band.

items.q: Will the band or the DJ play in costume?
items.a: Ask us with the booking. The musicians decide what they wear, and a themed set, the songs that belong to the night, is a request we take with the date.

items.q: How loud is it, and how late can it run?
items.a: It's a party, so once the floor fills it plays like one. The loud part of any home party belongs indoors once the neighbors have gone to bed, which is why the floor for this one is usually a finished basement, a garage with the cars out, or the main floor with the doors shut. If your street or HOA has quiet hours in writing, give them to us at contract and the night gets built under them.

items.q: How much space does a Halloween party band need?
items.a: A DJ takes about 6 by 4 feet on one dedicated circuit and 45 minutes to set up, a trio 12 by 8 on one, and a quartet or the karaoke four-piece 14 by 10 on two, and none of them want to share a circuit with the fog machine and the string lights. On a night when every house on the block has guests, tell us about the driveway or the alley and which door is ours. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks.
